prose: John Gruber notes that Xcode 27.2 supports a new JSON project file format - a notable step away from the famously merge-conflict-prone pbxproj plist that has defined Xcode projects for decades. (Summary based on the Daring Fireball post and Apple's Xcode 27.2 release notes.)
highlights: Xcode 27.2 introduces a JSON project file format
A break from the ancient, merge-hostile pbxproj plist format
Summary from Daring Fireball and Apple's release notes
